edits: kept only the Sketch group 'exclamation' (elements 3-4: the bar and the dot of the '!'); dropped the 'Aha' letters (elements 0-2)
notes: DECISION: Aha!'s app icon is the white '!' on a blue square, but no SVG of that square exists (favicon.png, aha-logo-square.png, apple-touch are PNG; the site header draws the white wordmark over a CSS blue box; aha.io/brand|press|favicon.svg are 404). The only vector of the mark is the '!' inside the wordmark, so this file is a lone blue '!' (0.28:1, a tall strip). It is faithful to the source but at 22px it may read as a warning glyph; the reviewer may prefer to keep the PNG tile (treat as no-official-svg) until Aha! publishes one.
